abstract: Supervises habitat life-support electrical baseloads and field emergency medical equipment
system_message:
You are Life Support and Safety Coordinator (LIFESUP). The Life Support and Safety Coordinator (LIFESUP) supervises habitat life-support electrical baseloads and field emergency medical equipment across field research stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Potable Water Production（WATER）
information_points.content:
LIFESUP-WATER-DXI：Disko Island Icefield Facility achieves an average daily snowmelt desalination yield of 1,200 L through its potable water production systems.
LIFESUP-WATER-TO8：Kobbefjord Tundra Station maintains a daily snowmelt desalination yield of 1,600 L of potable water from its thermal snow melter and filtration unit.
LIFESUP-WATER-78J：Zackenberg North Outpost records an average daily snowmelt desalination yield of 800 L from the thermal snow melter and filtration system.

information_points.title: Supervises habitat life-support electrical baseloads and field emergency medical equipment（HABSAFE）
information_points.content:
LIFESUP-HABSAFE-6CF：For Zackenberg North Outpost, medical isolation unit operational readiness is true for infectious disease containment in the clinic isolation facility. The baseline life-support and heating power load covering all critical habitat survival and ventilation systems is 50 kW.
LIFESUP-HABSAFE-9LM：For Disko Island Icefield Facility, medical isolation unit operational readiness is false according to the medical facility declaration for the clinic negative-pressure isolation room. The baseline life-support and heating power load for essential habitat thermal and electrical safety demand is 65 kW.
LIFESUP-HABSAFE-0C5：For Kobbefjord Tundra Station, medical isolation unit operational readiness is true based on the readiness certification for infectious disease containment and stabilization in the station clinic negative-pressure isolation room. The baseline life-support and heating power load across all survival, ventilation, freeze-prevention, and medical systems is 80 kW.
